description: A photo with a bold meme-style caption: full-bleed, or pasted as a tilted card on the dark background (the 'receipt' look).

fields.caption: Bold outlined caption (keep it short). *word* = accent color
fields.mode: full (default: photo fills the frame) or card (photo as a tilted card on the dark background)
fields.photo_pos: Which part of the photo to keep in full mode, CSS object-position (default center)
fields.dim: Darken the photo 0-1 so the caption reads (default 0.15)
